## Full-Stack Web App - Project Tracker : [https://miniprojecttracker.vercel.app](https://miniprojecttracker.vercel.app)

A full-stack project and task management hub with team collaboration. Designed with with role-based access control (RBAC), real-time task audit logging, interactive drag and drop workflows, and notifications for assigned tasks and @mentions

> The dashboard is populated with demo data. Changes made during demo access are not persistent. Logging into demo access wipes saved data and fills in demo data
